name: RIWF E3 noisy T-Maze confirmatory plan
why_fallback: The revision plan named RockSample(11,11) with a pre-specified fallback to a T-Maze whose cue reliability and reward scale depend on a visible regime. A RockSample(5,5) pilot on CPU converged to the exit-at-once policy (return 10, no checks, no samples), so no candidate differed in what it sensed. The fallback keeps the property E3 exists to test: agents that differ in how much they sense.
environment: POBAX T-Maze dynamics with three changes: a fresh noisy goal reading at every step on the start cell (north and south there do nothing, so staying is the sensing action), a visible regime bit, and a start flag. Regime 0 reads at 0.95 and pays +4 or -0.1. Regime 1 reads at 0.70 and pays +8 or -4. Step limit 4(L+2)+16.
shift: source hallways 5-10 with regime 1 in 10 percent of episodes. Target hallways 10-20 with regime 1 in half of the episodes.

pilots.gate: risky-regime readings at the junction differ by at least one reading across candidates, and refit target return spans at least one return unit across candidates

pool: GRU and LSTM with width 8, 32, 128 and the gated transformer with window 8 or 32, each trained with regime 1 at its natural 10 percent or raised to 50 percent, snapshots at updates 150 and 300: 32 candidates per world
memory: the feature the policy head reads at the first step at the junction
admission: a candidate is admitted when its native source return is within 1.0 of the best candidate in its world
teacher: set network with sum pooling over the observation history, trained on labelled source histories up to the junction

selectors.fp4: max, predicted return of the refitted readout: informed return on reached episodes minus acquisition (stake x min(p, 1-p)) minus reach x return-weighted linear-language deficit
selectors.fk4: max, same with the nearest-neighbour readout
selectors.d_ret: min, return-weighted linear deficit alone (aliasing only)
selectors.tpe: max, teacher-based policy evaluation of the native actor in return units

modes.refit: native movement, junction decision by the linear readout refitted on the panel with return weights, endpoint l_ret

hypotheses.H2: fp4 beats nat_val and each teacher-free selector on l_ret
hypotheses.H4: tpe wins on n_ret and fp4 wins on l_ret
hypotheses.H10: P4: fp4 beats d_ret (aliasing only) and acq (acquisition only) on l_ret
hypotheses.H11: return weights beat success and unit weights: selecting by d_ret beats d_suc and d_one on l_ret
hypotheses.H12: the P4 split: realised refit shortfall from the informed return equals acquisition plus aliasing plus execution, each estimated by the teacher within the measured teacher error
